questions.q: What does the logit lens technique do, precisely?
options: It trains a brand-new classifier from scratch on each layer's activations
It applies the transformer's own final unembedding matrix and layer norm to an intermediate residual-stream activation, as if the model stopped there
It only works on the model's attention weights, never the residual stream
It removes the unembedding matrix entirely and replaces it with random weights
questions.explain: The logit lens reuses the model's own final-step computation (layer norm plus unembedding) on an earlier layer's residual stream to see what prediction that layer's state would produce.

questions.q: What did nostalgebraist's original logit-lens analysis of GPT-2 find about how predictions form across layers?
options: Predictions form gradually: early layers often give unreadable or near-random guesses, middle layers reach a plausible guess, and later layers progressively sharpen it into the final output
Predictions remain identical to the input token all the way through the final layer
Predictions appear fully correct starting from the very first layer
Predictions get progressively worse the deeper into the model you look
questions.explain: The key finding was gradual sharpening: a vague or unreadable guess early, converging toward the model's actual final prediction as depth increases.

questions.q: What is the core assumption the logit lens relies on, and why is it a potential problem?
options: It assumes the vocabulary size is always exactly 50,000 tokens
It assumes every layer has the exact same number of parameters, which is trivially true
It assumes the model was trained without any regularization
It assumes the final layer's unembedding matrix is also a valid decoder for intermediate layers' representational geometry, which may not hold if that geometry shifts across depth
questions.explain: If the residual stream's representational basis changes somewhat across layers, applying the final-layer decoder to an earlier layer may measure a mismatch rather than that layer's own faithful prediction.

questions.q: How does the tuned lens address the logit lens's main limitation?
options: By requiring the entire model to be retrained from scratch
By deleting the unembedding matrix entirely and never decoding to vocabulary space
By training a separate small affine probe for each layer specifically to decode that layer's own residual stream, rather than reusing the final layer's unembedding as-is
By only ever looking at the very last layer of the model
questions.explain: The tuned lens trains a per-layer affine probe tailored to each layer's own geometry, and was shown to be more predictive and reliable than directly reusing the final unembedding.

questions.q: What is the recommended way to interpret a logit-lens trace, according to this lesson?
options: As a definitive, causal explanation of the model's intention at every layer
As a replacement for ever needing to look at attention patterns or probing results
As proof that the model has no internal computation before the final layer
As a useful, cheap window into how a prediction evolves across depth, read with skepticism rather than as a literal causal readout of intent
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly cautions against over-claiming: the logit lens is a useful exploratory signal about depth-wise prediction evolution, not a settled causal account, especially at early layers.
